lessons: The implementation and review both passed (3064 tests, approve). Merge failed only because the main checkout has uncommitted edits to chupa/specs/requisition_review.md and tests/test_specs.py, and the squash would overwrite them.

A human must inspect the uncommitted edits to chupa/specs/requisition_review.md and tests/test_specs.py in the main checkout, then commit or revert them. That is the dirty_checkout paved road. After that the ticket re-runs through the normal retry path.

Do not change the implementation on the next attempt. The diff already meets every Scope-in item: coverage_map is a required keyword with no default, a missing or invalid declared map snags as coverage_map, and the spec is at 3.1 with the fenced-or-cleared rule.
